sources.name: Google-owned Colab browser bridge
sources.note: Bootstrap open_colab_browser_connection, then dynamic browser notebook tools. This service implements owner-interactive ipynb import/export/setup, not an invented fixed execution API.

sources.name: Official hosted Colab MCP, distinct from browser import/export
sources.note: Official API exists. Authenticated hosted session/execution/file-transfer integration is NOT implemented by this worker; no false claim that Colab has no API.

sources.name: OpenSSH client contract
sources.note: System ssh, fixed remote python3 command, batch mode, explicit known-hosts file, StrictHostKeyChecking=yes, -F none, no shell interpolation of request data. Live handshake remains NOT_RUN.
